name: Shark Go
summary:
Shark GO is an underwater VR action-adventure game focused on marine exploration, creature collection, and oceanic combat. Set in a fully immersive deep-sea environment, players navigate the ocean floor utilizing 360-degree locomotion mechanics designed for high-speed swimming and creature riding. The core gameplay loop revolves around locating aquatic species, capturing them, and retrofitting them with customizable equipment to create personalized combat mounts.

The title supports a progression system where players earn experience points (EXP) through environmental interactions and combat encounters. This leveling system scales from levels 1 to 10, granting access to increasingly difficult regional ocean bosses. Shark GO includes built-in multiplayer functionality, facilitating cooperative Player versus Environment (PvE) boss raids alongside competitive Player versus Player (PvP) arena configurations.
